evidence.locator: license text, Section 0 definition of 'Font' and Section 2 Modification, especially clauses (b)-(c) and the following scope paragraph; this is a custom license limited to four named Arphic TrueType fonts and their derivatives, with GPL-like whole-font reciprocity and special font-file conditions, rather than a general software-license family

license text, Section 2(b) and the paragraph following Section 2(c): modifications must be Freely Available as a whole under this License, and the requirements apply to the modified work as a whole, while independent separate works and mere aggregation are excluded

license text, Preamble; Section 0 definition of 'Freely Available'; Sections 1-2 and 4: use, verbatim distribution, and modification of the defined Font are permitted, including charging for the copying or redistribution service; changing glyphs, format, character coverage, and font name is expressly permitted, but embedding and the breadth of commercial exploitation or sublicensing are not stated in vocabulary-equivalent terms and are represented by unknown

license text, Section 1 and Sections 2(a)-(c): every copy must retain ARPHICPL.TXT unaltered; each modified file must prominently state how and when it changed; modifications must be Freely Available as a whole under this License; and a qualifying interactive modified font must display copyright, warranty, redistribution, and license-access notices; the special availability and interactive-announcement details are represented by unknown

license text, Sections 1-2 and 5: distribution activates license-file retention, automatic receipt, and no-further-restrictions terms, while modification activates file marking and whole-font same-license availability; copying and starting a qualifying interactive modified font are additional triggers absent from the vocabulary and are represented by unknown

license text, Sections 3, 5, 7, and 8: unauthorized copying, modification, sublicensing, or distribution voids rights; recipients may not face further restrictions; warranty is disclaimed and liability is limited; embedding treatment, the special availability condition, and automatic retroactive termination are not represented losslessly and are represented by unknown

license text, Section 6 Contradiction and whole-text review: patent infringement and royalty-bearing patent licenses are discussed only as potentially conflicting obligations that can bar distribution; no express patent grant or patent-litigation termination is stated

license text, Section 1 and Sections 2(a)-(c): all copies must retain the unaltered license file, every modified file needs a prominent dated change notice, and qualifying interactive modified fonts need a multi-part runtime announcement, creating a material file-level notice burden

license metadata, deprecated=false, osi=false, fsf=false; license text, Section 0 and Sections 1-8: the license is confined to four named Arphic fonts and their derivatives, and the recommendation vocabulary cannot losslessly encode font embedding, font-name changes, the precise commercial-service permission, modification availability, conditional interactive notices, patent-conflict consequences, or the font-only whole-work scope, so it is unsuitable for automatic recommendation as a general software license
